label: Lembert Studio Program · 2027
title: A Year of Creation
opening: One year. You go fully for what you want to create, and you put down what is no longer needed. The parts of the business you have outgrown and kept anyway. The commitments you honour out of habit. The version of yourself that was useful five years ago.

Most ambitious people are told to pick. Results or peace. Money or presence. Scale or health. I have never found that trade to be real. It is a story people accept early and then build an entire life around.

This year is for the other option. You create results and you are at peace while you do it. You make more money and you are more available to the people you love. Not balanced carefully against each other. Both, fully, at the same time.
questions: Have you ever dared to want what you want fully, and hold it as possible for longer than a day?

What happens in twelve months with seven other people who are all playing full out, who all treat failure as one more iteration, and who will not let you quietly shrink your own ambition back to something comfortable?
callToQuestion: Are you willing to create a year that looks impossible from where you stand right now?
qualifications: You run a business and it is your full time occupation. You are willing to take action that creates real movement in income, freedom, health and aliveness.
You want to play a significant game. Not a slightly larger version of the game you are playing now.
I repeat: you have to be willing to have success. This sounds obvious. It is not. Most people want it and then arrange their life so it stays just out of reach.
You bring the truth into a room of people doing the same. No performing, no managing your image. The work only happens at that level.
notForLabel: This is not for you if
notFor: you are looking for a list of actions, a guru or permission
you want results without being willing to change
you need it to be reasonable before you say yes
you want to argue for the limitations of your life more than for its possibility
closing: If something in you resonates, even if you cannot justify wanting it, let us talk.
